title: Blogger Operators & Expressions Master Catalog
description: Canonical machine-readable catalog of Blogger expression operators, dual-syntax execution grammar, 10-level precedence hierarchy, operand typing, and compiler quotas.

precedence_hierarchy.category: Arithmetic (Additive), URL, Date, Image & Snippet Transforms

compiler_quotas.token_cost_rules: 1 token per operator (2 for ternary ? :), 1 per literal/operand (including unary negative numbers), 1 per data path (including static and dynamic bracket indexing), 1 per array/object container, 1 per grouping parentheses pair ( ... ), 0 for argument parentheses in function calls/lambdas, and 0 for object property keys and delimiters (, and :)

concatenation.name: Concatenation
concatenation.description: String concatenation and scalar text interpolation.

arithmetic.name: Arithmetic
arithmetic.description: Numeric addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and modulo.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.description: Relational comparisons and value equality checks.

logical.name: Logical
logical.description: Logical conjunction, disjunction, and boolean inversion.

membership.name: Membership
membership.description: Tests whether an item exists within a collection or string.

content.name: Content
content.description: Substring search and item containment checks.

collection.name: Collection
collection.description: Array slicing, pagination limits, and numeric sequence generation.

lambda.name: Lambda / Collection Pipeline
lambda.description: Higher-order collection predicates, projection mapping, and aggregation reductions.

ternary.name: Ternary / Conditional
ternary.description: Inline conditional branching expression (cond ? val1 : val2).

elvis.name: Coalescence / Fallback
elvis.description: Fallback value selector for nullish or empty operands (?:).

url.name: Transform / URL
url.description: URL path segment joining, query parameter appending, and hash fragmenting.

date.name: Transform / Date
date.description: Localized date formatting using ICU pattern tokens.

image.name: Transform / Image
image.description: Google CDN image thumbnail resizing and responsive srcset generation.

snippet.name: Transform / Truncation
snippet.description: Text truncation, snippet extraction, and HTML tag stripping.

+.description: Performs numeric addition on numbers or string concatenation when at least one operand is text (ad-hoc polymorphism).

overloads.description: Arithmetic addition on numbers or skin dimension lengths
String concatenation and scalar text interpolation

-.description: Performs arithmetic subtraction on numbers/lengths or unary negation.

/.description: Division of numbers rendered with up to 4 decimal places.
anti_patterns: Division by zero aborts expression evaluation.
Modulo by zero aborts expression evaluation.
Do not use JavaScript '===' triple equals in Blogger expressions.
Do not use JavaScript '!==' in Blogger expressions.

<=.description: Less than or equal relational comparison.

>=.description: Greater than or equal relational comparison.

and.description: Logical conjunction returning true if both operands are truthy.
anti_patterns: Avoid JavaScript '&&' in XML attributes to prevent XML entity escaping collisions; prefer keyword 'and'.

or.description: Logical disjunction returning true if either operand is truthy.
anti_patterns: Avoid JavaScript '||' in expressions; prefer keyword 'or' or elvis '?:'.

in.description: Tests whether an element exists within an array or character sequence within a string.

contains.description: Tests whether a string contains a substring or an array contains an item (haystack contains needle).
anti_patterns: Do not use JavaScript .includes() or .indexOf(); use keyword operator 'contains'.

take.description: Extracts up to N items from the beginning of an array.

operands.name: count
operands.description: Maximum number of items to take

anti_patterns: Do not use JavaScript .slice() to limit collections; use 'take' or 'limit'.

skip.description: Bypasses the first N items of an array and returns the remaining elements.

operands.name: count
operands.description: Number of leading items to skip

to.description: Generates an array sequence of integers between two integer bounds (inclusive). Exclusive to <b:loop values='...'>.
anti_patterns: 'to' is valid exclusively within <b:loop values='...'>; using 'to' in cond or b:eval is invalid.

any.description: Quantifier returning true if at least one item satisfies the arrow predicate.
anti_patterns: Do not prefix iterator properties with 'data:' inside the lambda body (e.g. p.title, never data:p.title).

all.description: Quantifier returning true if every element in the collection satisfies the arrow predicate.

none.description: Quantifier returning true if zero items in the collection satisfy the arrow predicate.

count.description: Counts the number of elements in a collection that satisfy the arrow predicate.

map.description: Projects each element into a new transformed array using the lambda expression.
anti_patterns: Do not use JavaScript .map() method; use keyword operator: array map (p => ...)

filter.description: Filters an array keeping only elements satisfying the boolean predicate.
anti_patterns: Do not use JavaScript .filter() method; use keyword operator: array filter (p => ...)

first.description: Extracts the first element satisfying the predicate, or null if none match.

?:.description: Elvis operator returning fallback value if left operand evaluates to null or empty.

operands.name: target
operands.description: Value to inspect for nullish/empty state

? :.description: Inline conditional branching expression (condition ? truthyValue : falsyValue).
anti_patterns: Concatenation '+' binds tighter than ternary; always wrap ternary in parentheses when concatenating.

path.description: Replaces the path portion of a URL while preserving existing query parameters and hash fragments.

params.description: Sets or replaces query parameters on a URL using key-values from a dictionary object.
anti_patterns: Mandatory whitespace after colons in object literals { key: value } to avoid namespace collisions.

appendParams.description: Merges and appends additional query parameters to a URL without removing existing parameters.

fragment.description: Appends or replaces the anchor/hash fragment identifier of a URL.

format.description: Formats a timestamp date value using an ICU date-time format pattern string.

resizeImage.description: Rewrites Google CDN image URLs for resizing, aspect ratio cropping, or responsive datasets.

operands.name: size
operands.description: Target dimension or array of dimensions

overloads.description: Array of responsive image objects with .url and .size

anti_patterns: Only works on Google-hosted image infrastructure; guard with .isResizable modifier.

sourceSet.description: Generates an HTML srcset string formatted as 'URL w<size>, ...' from an image URL and dimensions array.

snippet.description: Extracts a truncated plain-text snippet from markup or text, stripping HTML tags.

operands.name: options
operands.description: Snippet options: length, links, linebreaks, ellipsis

anti_patterns: Whitespace required after colon in options dictionary: { length: 150, links: false }.
